note: Committed canonicalization vectors for the rich-UI manifest. Read with include_bytes! and marked -text in .gitattributes, so the digests here are computed over the bytes every platform checks out.

cases.name: rfc8785-3.2.2-and-3.2.3-primitives-sorting
cases.note: RFC 8785 sections 3.2.2 and 3.2.3: numbers in ECMAScript form, strings escaped per ECMA-262, members sorted by UTF-16 code unit. The published example's fractional numbers are written here as integers, because manifest objects carry integers only.

cases.name: rfc8785-3.2.3-property-sorting
cases.note: RFC 8785 section 3.2.3's sorting data. A UTF-8 comparison would put the emoji first; UTF-16 code units put it after the Euro sign, and U+0080 is written as itself rather than as an escape.

input.ö: Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis

cases.canonical: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

cases.name: manifest-every-construct-sorts-recursively
cases.note: Members sort at every depth and array order is kept, which makes the manifest digest independent of the order the builder fills its maps in.

cases.name: manifest-string-escaping
cases.note: RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.2: only U+0000..U+001F, quote and backslash are escaped; a solidus, DEL and non-ASCII text stay literal.

cases.name: manifest-integer-bounds-pass
cases.note: The manifest number rule's exact bounds: +-(2^53-1) is accepted, and negative numbers keep their sign.

cases.name: manifest-fraction-is-refused
cases.note: A fractional number in a manifest object must fail the builder: a reader that parses it as a double cannot promise the value the writer meant.

cases.name: manifest-integer-beyond-the-safe-range-is-refused
cases.note: One past 2^53 loses precision as a double, so the builder refuses it rather than publishing a different number.

cases.name: manifest-negative-integer-beyond-the-safe-range-is-refused
cases.note: The same bound on the negative side.
